notes.title: DISCOVER OUR PREMIUM COLLECTOR’S EDITION OF TEKKEN 8!
notes.content:
[h3]The long-awaited TEKKEN 8 is due to be released on [b]26th January 2024[/b]. 

The [b]Premium Collector’s Edition[/b] of TEKKEN 8 includes the [b]full game[/b], along with [b]unique collectible items[/b] and [b]additional digital content[/b].[/h3]

[h3]Experience the next chapter in the[b] longest-running videogame storyline[/b] with [b]32 redesigned unique fighters[/b] and master the all-new [b]‘Heat’ system[/b] to crush your opponents. Enjoy [b]high-fidelity graphics[/b], developed for the new generation of hardware to[b] showcase every moment of impact and aggressive super moves[/b].

With a variety of single-player content to explore, such as the [b]brand-new Arcade Quest mode[/b] and an [b]in-depth customization system[/b] for both playable and avatar characters, TEKKEN 8 introduces [b]the most thrilling experience yet[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/a15fd90821f4f18716fbe949db8ba3a1c1395b6f.png[/img]

[h2]🤜 Introducing our [url=https://bnent.eu/TK8PremiumPC][u][b]Store Exclusive Premium Collector's Edition[/b][/u][/url] - a [b]true treasure trove for our most dedicated fans![/b] 🤛[/h2]

[previewyoutube=RVJWMa6BYRM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Inside, you'll find an array of [b]exceptional items[/b] that celebrate the world of TEKKEN 8:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Full Game TEKKEN 8:[/b] Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of TEKKEN 8 and experience the new gen fighting game like never before.
[*] [b]Exclusive Electrified Figurine of Jin: [/b]For the ardent TEKKEN 8 enthusiasts, we present a stunning 25cm tall Jin Kazama figurine. Perched upon an iconic burning chains pedestal, this electrifying collectible embodies Jin's essence with meticulous detail, right down to his signature wing.
[*] [b]Arcade Token:[/b] A 5 cm arcade token featuring the iconic Jin VS Kazuya face-off and a cherished keepsake that pays homage to TEKKEN's enduring arcade legacy.
[*] [b]Leroy Smith Metal Ring:[/b] Elevate your style with the Leroy Smith Metal Ring, complete with a luxurious velvet pouch. This finely crafted piece showcases Leroy Smith's unique charm and adds a touch of sophistication to any fan's attire.
[*] [b]Collectible Cards: [/b]Enhance your TEKKEN 8 collection with a set of 8 glossy collectible cards, each featuring stunning artwork and iconic characters - a must-have for both fans and collectors.
[*] [b]Steelbook: [/b]Our special face-off steelbook is a premium addition to your TEKKEN 8 collection. It beautifully showcases iconic characters locked in a fierce face-off, making it a true collector's gem.
[*] [b]Collector’s Box:[/b] Store your TEKKEN treasures in style with the exclusive box. This elegant container not only keeps your collectibles safe but also proudly displays your passion for the TEKKEN franchise.

[*] [b]Metal Plate with the Burning Chain[/b] (*Available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe): This artfully designed metal plate showcases the iconic Burning Chain, making it a unique and eye-catching addition to your collection.
[/list]
[h3]But that's not all! Our Premium Collector's Edition also includes [b]a wealth of digital content[/b] to enhance your gaming experience:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Playable Character Year 1 Pass: [/b]Gain access to 4 additional playable characters, along with the exclusive avatar skin: Kinjin.
[*] [b]Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack[/b] - Dress up your favorite characters with this dazzling costume pack, featuring one unique outfit for each of the 32 playable characters.
[*] [b]Avatar Costume: Classic TEKKEN T-shirt set[/b] - Show your TEKKEN spirit with the 32 different designs for your avatars.
[*] [b]Avatar Skins: Kazuya Mishima, Jin Kazama, and Jun Kazama[/b] - Transform into your favorite TEKKEN characters with these iconic character avatar skins![/list]

notes.title: Update Ver. 5.10
notes.content:
[h3]Addition of New Customization Items[/h3]

The version 5.10 Character Panel Set has been added.


[h3]Addition of Streaming Mode[/h3]

Streaming Mode has been added to the Game Options.
When Streaming Mode is activated, the online ID/gamertag of the opponent on the VS screen and the battle screen in Ranked Match, Player Match, and Quick Match will be replaced to the character name.


[h3]Expanded Character Selection Features[/h3]

Players can now register their favorite character and costume combination and select it with one button.
We also added a feature that remembers the last costume that was selected until the game is closed.


[h3]Modified Tournament Settings[/h3]

We made some modifications to the Tournament Settings in Game Options. When Tournament Settings are switched on, players will not be able to use the following character selection features in the Versus Battle:
[list][*] "Favorite" settings
[*]  Character costume selection
[*]  Saving of last costume selected[/list]
[h3]Updated Connection Status Info Display[/h3]

We made the following changes to the connection status info display:
[list]
[*] Connection status info display format updated.
[*] Text color in some parts of the display updated to show sync status.
[*] Info added on the processing load of the PCs used in the match.
[/list]

notes.title: 🥊 Season 4 of TEKKEN 7 has now started!
notes.content:
[h1]New moves are available for all characters, and adjustments were made to game balance as well. Also, additional new features TEKKEN PROWESS, a new highest rank and online play enhancements are implemented.[/h1]

[h2]Season Pass 4, DLC 16 and 17 will be available from November 10th 🦊🌸

------------------------------------------------------

STEAM® Ver.4.00 Update Note[/h2]

Update data Ver.4.00 will include the following elements :

[h3]●	Battle balance adjustment[/h3]

Made adjustments related to game balance for all characters.

[i]*Recorded battles in MY REPLAY&TIPS from previous versions cannot be used after this update due to the change of battle balance.[/i]

[h3]●	New function TEKKEN PROWESS[/h3]

The display of TEKKEN PROWESS is added to battles in each online related mode. 
TEKKEN PROWESS is the new indicator of a player’s total strength and skill in TEKKEN.
A player’s online ID color will change depending on their TEKKEN PROWESS.
The display of TEKKEN PROWESS will be also added to LEADERBOARDS and PLAYER INFORMATION.

[h3]●	Adjustment of online rank[/h3]

[b][The new highest rank][/b]
The new highest rank “TEKKEN God Omega” is added.

[b][Adjustment of rank point][/b]
The necessary points in which a rank goes up and down will be changed ranks over “True TEKKEN God”.

[b][Losing Streak countdown][/b]
A losing streak display is added in rank point gauge for a match of players who are TEKKEN God Prime and above. When a player loses 3 times in a row, rank points will be decreased more than usual.

[b][Rank reset][/b]
Due to the rank point adjustment and the implementation of TEKKEN PROWESS, online rank for Season 4 is reset to a certain rank based the rank from Season 3.

[i]*Ranking on LEADERBOARDS will only be updated when a player’s highest rank is updated.
[/i]
[h3]●	Online play enhancement[/h3]

[b][Response improvement (Rollback/Net-code improvement)][/b]
Perceived delay happening during online matches is improved.

[b][Wi-fi indicator][/b]
An icon is displayed to indicate a WiFi connection during online matching.

[i]*Wireless connection might be caused a delay or display lag during a match.
For smooth online matchings, it is recommended to use wired connection play. 
[/i]
[h3]●	Renewal of user interface[/h3]

A part of user interface is renewed, and BGM is also updated.
The design of health bar is also updated.

[h3]●	Renewal of ARENA stage[/h3]

Celebrating to PAC-MAN 40th Anniversary, the design of ARENA stage is changed to the special state.

[i]*During the celebration period, BGM of ARENA stage is also changed.[/i]

[h3]●	Adjustment of item appearance rate in TREASURE BATTLE[/h3]

Increase the ratio of character’s item appearance rate in TREASURE BATTLE.

[h3]●	Added illustrations to GALLERY[/h3]

New illustrations will be added to GALLERY of [TEKKEN 7].

notes.title: Season Pass 3 Release Date & Update Ver. 3.00 Notes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AWeyEiPhTFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready for Season 3? 
Zafina the Spiritual Warrior joins the fight on September 10 with a new set of costumes, and Wing Chun expert Leroy Smith will follow this winter. 
Along with Season Pass 3, we’re releasing a free update featuring new character moves, player stats and more!

-----------------------------------
Update Ver. 3.00 Patch Notes
-----------------------------------

Update data Ver. 3.00 will include the following elements: 

● Battle balance adjustment
Made adjustments to game balance for all characters

● New function PLAY STATS
PLAY STATS and STAGE WIN RATE functions will be added to PLAYER INFORMATION. 3 TOP STATS from PLAY STATS will be shown in online match.

● Expanded character select function
Unique costumes for each character will be added to customize slot as Pre-set slots. 

● Adjustment of online rank
Online ranks now start from 1st dan.
The rank of characters with a rank from Beginner to 1st kyu will be changed to 1st dan.

● Renewal of user interface
Elements of the user interface such as main menu or character select will be renewed.
 
● Added illustrations to GALLERY
New illustrations will be added to the GALLERY of TEKKEN 7.

[u]Full details:[/u] [url=http://bnent.eu/T7Patch300]http://bnent.eu/T7Patch300[/url]

notes.title: TEKKEN 7 FREE 2nd Anniversary Update
notes.content:
A free update has been released today to celebrate [b]TEKKEN 7’s 2nd Anniversary[/b]! 🎉
Players will get access to many new customization items, including a new costume for Negan, new battle effects, flags, wings and more! 

[b]Ver.2.30 Update Note[/b]
This update includes the following:

● Made adjustments to game balance for certain characters 
Read the full details from [url=http://bnent.eu/T7Patch230]this page[/url].

● Added new customization items 
Added items as part of the 2nd-year anniversary, as well as new customization options for Negan.
After you implement the update data and restart the game, the relevant items will be available.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: TEKKEN 7 Update Ver. 2.21
notes.content:
Update Ver. 2.21 introduces the following improvement:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue that caused Craig Marduk and Armor King's in-game ranks and stats to reset. 
[/list]

We have fixed instances in which players who connect online after applying Ver. 2.20 would find the in-game ranks and stats of Craig Marduk and Armor King reset. 

Please note that this fix will not restore any lost in-game rank or stats. We are investigating the possibility of restoring in-game ranks or stats that were lost due to this issue. We will be releasing more information regarding the outcome of our investigation on our official site. 

We apologize for any inconvenience caused. Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Ver. 2.20 Update Notice
notes.content:
We have confirmed that after applying Ver. 2.20, Craig Marduk and Armor King's in-game rank and stats reset in some cases.

We are currently working to find a solution. Thank you for your patience and continued support!

notes.title: Julia & Negan + Patch 2.20 OUT NOW in TEKKEN 7
notes.content:
She’s ready to broadcast her next fights and he’s about to give them a taste of Lucille. [b]Julia[/b] and [b]Negan[/b] from [b]The Walking Dead[/b] are coming to TEKKEN 7’s Season Pass 2 today!

In addition, patch 2.20 is available now, bringing the following features and improvements: 

[list]
[*] Support for Julia Chang (DLC #8) and the Negan Pack (DLC #9) has been added
[*] Made adjustments to game balance
[*] New stages have been added
[*] The "Simple Select" feature has been added
[*] New music has been added to the jukebox
[*] Fixed various bugs
[*] New Warm-Up feature has been added during standby
[/list]

[url=http://bnent.eu/T7Patch220]Read the full patch notes here[/url].

notes.title: Tekken 7 fighters get buff in season 2 patch notes
notes.content:
Stop hitting yourself. Stop hitting yourself. OK, listen, please stop hitting yourself, just for a second. I have Tekken 7 news. The demon-thumping biff em up is getting a big update this week, alongside its second season of characters, and it has released the patch notes for it s current characters. As is customary for fighting games, there are a lot of tiny adjustments to frame data, meaning characters go a teeny-weeny bit faster or an ickle-wickle bit slower as they break each other’s jaws. But the notes also highlight moves that ll cause a wall bounce . That s the new feature that will see your poor panda ricocheting off the cage and into your opponent s follow-up boot. Ouch.
(more…)

notes.content: Hey everyone! Patch 1.13.3 for TEKKEN 7 is now live. This patch implements measures to discourage behavior that violates the service agreement during ONLINE play. See you in the ring!

notes.title: Patch 1.09 - New Version to be released on December 3rd
notes.content:
The following items will be adjusted in update patch ver. 1.09

ONLINE MODE
- During Warm-up, if the opponent found notification window times out, opponent search will be suspended.

- Antenna during opponent search has been adjusted.
Some players that were previously shown as ‘5’ will now be displayed as ‘4’
When max players is set to ‘2’ in Player Match, the option to select ‘Rematch’ after a battle has been added.
 
- Leaderboard Improvement
A ranking divided by character has been added to  ‘Rank Match Wins’. 

GAME STABILITY
Game stability has been improved in ONLINE MODE, Ultimate TEKKEN BOWL, during battles, during some stages, and in some customization screens.

Fixed system failure which causes a crash with PC linked to multiple network adapters

notes.title: Tekken 7 – September 20th update – Patch Notes
notes.content:
Moveset adjustments 

Hwoarang - Rage Drive - Made a modification so that rage meter is spent when the third attack is executed instead of the second.
- Human Cannonball - Fixed an issue where Hwoarang sometimes can't catch an opponent after he slides. 

Xiaoyu - During Phoenix - Opponents are now knocked back shorter distance when blocking this move.
・An opponent's hit now becomes an aerial hit when it lands while guarding.

Bryan Fury - Snake Edge - Expanded the hit box.

Jack 7 - Rage Art - Expanded the hit box.

Dragnov - Clipping Sweep - Hit box is generated 2F later than before.
Pommel Swing - Hit box is generated 1F later than before.
While rising - Expanded the hit box.

Lili - Edelweiss - Expanded the hit box.

Leo - Gui Xi - Opponents are now knocked back shorter distance when blocking this move.
・Increased the recovery frame by 1F when the move is blocked and when the move whiffed.
・Increased the recovery frame by 4F when the move whiffed.

Lucky Chloe - Rage Drive - Rage drive While crouching・The first attack Opponents' block stun is now increased by 8F.
・Hit box of the first attack now remains 1F longer.
・The opponent is now knocked back shorter distance when the first attack hits.
・An opponent's block stun is increased by 7F when the 2nd attack is blocked.
・ Up Step While crouching・Hit box remains 1F longer.

Josie - Step in Tracer ・Expanded the hit box.
・Hit box remains 1F longer.

Gigas - Hell Crusher
During Goliath ・Hit box remains 2F longer.
Monster Axe	・Expand the hit box of 2nd attack.
Repelling Blast・Hit box remains 1F longer.

Kazumi - Crimson Dawn・Shorten the reach of first attack

Nina	- Sideslip・Changed the status to crouching.
・Modified the collision to make it easier to land the attack.

Master Raven	While crouching ・Expanded the hit box.
・Crouching status remains 8F longer.

Lee - Laser Edge Lee Somersault ・Modified the motion and now the character moves forward for more distance.
- Rear Cross Punch・Expanded the hit box.
- Grass Snake・Available to use this skill even entering as well.
- Twister Heel/While rising・Decreased the block stun by 2F.
・Modified the motion and the character moves forward for more distance.
- Silver Tail/While crouching・Fixed an issue where crouching status disappeared when inputting and transitioning to a stance.

Eddy - Rage drive - Increased the block stun by 7F when the first attack is blocked.

Eliza - Dark Blade Chaos・Improved the homing ability of the move.
- Dark Cannon - AirBorne Dark Cannon During jump・Increased the block stun by 3F.
- Rending Claw・Changed an opponent's behavior when the move hits.

notes.title: Tekken 7 – July 28th update – Patch Notes
notes.content:
Tekken 7 has been updated today with a new patch to improve the overall playing experience.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25339077/ecd5bf8853d09f16421f646a2e42c26c1975c2a3.png[/img]
The changes include:
- The black color for customization is now set to true black again and the issues with some character’s alternate costumes are fixed. 
- Improved matchmaking timing in all online modes. 
- Player’s information including character, wins, grade and title are no longer displayed during matchmaking
- Removed Match Lists following the improvement in matchmaking.
- Improved menu and navigation in Player Match. The change notably allow players to leave sessions more easily.
- Lifted the restriction on revenge matches in Ranked Match, to enables unlimited revenge matches.
- Fixed a revenge match related issue where the opponent’s name could change upon having revenge matches.

Please keep on discussing on the issues you could experience with Tekken 7 with us in the Steam forums.

Your next challenger awaits.
The Tekken team

notes.title: Tekken 7 update addresses some lingering issues
notes.content:
Given that Tekken 7 was the first instalment to hit PC, many expected it to launch in a less-than-perfect state. But it turned out the PC version was actually very good, helped along by the fact, no doubt, that it was developed on PC using Unreal Engine 4. There were a few lingering issues though, which a new patch will hopefully iron out.

Released today, the new patch doesn't address anything game-breaking – because by all reports, there are no game-breaking bugs – but they'll come welcome to some. Players can now view past the 97th rank on leaderboards, for example, while minimizing the game's window will no longer prevent it from being re-maximised.

Elsewhere, hackers will now be matched with other hackers, thus sheltering those who wish to play the game properly. Here are the full patch notes:

  • Fixes an issue where the leaderboard only shows until the 97th rank and players can't jump to their own ranking.
  • Fixes an issue where players can't resume the game after minimizing the app's Window.
  • Updates the matching version to ensure hackers will not be matched with legit users anymore.
  • Fixes Nina's Ivory Cutter, Eddy's rage arts and Miguel's power crash move.
  • Fixes an issue where sometimes both controls are assigned to 1P in VERSUS battle.
  • Fixes an issue where the keyboard becomes unresponsive after reconnecting USB devices.
  • Fixes issues where customized Kazuya's 3D model partially disappears.



The full post can be perused over the Steam Community page. If you've yet to play the game, maybe our review will help you make the leap.
